Notes_and_Tips: Since oily foods are disliked, keep cooking methods boiled, grilled or lightly pan cooked.
Because overeating happens once you start, serve one fixed plate and avoid eating directly from large vessels.
For better physique improvement, keep protein portions steady and rice moderate.
Stress can increase spicy cravings, so include spice in home cooked meals instead of outside food.
Simple clean meals will help maintain steady energy and long term consistency.
